name: dsh-purge
description: DeepSeek Harness 破甲：让所有模型都能破甲，不同模型可换不同提示词；默认提示词面向国模「小码酱」。Jailbreak for every model — swap prompts per model. 求 Star 收藏 ⭐ 如要二开，请查看署名要求部分

features: current DSH_HOME prompt, rules and skills
conversation retry, continue and rewind interfaces
missing-only RedTeam assets and additive legacy schema migration
Desktop isolated candidate install, Host restart and profile activation compatibility
limitations: Apply and Revert affect only private copies owned by the current profile and require manually quitting and restarting that DSH client.
Official ASAR, global CLI, native self-update, self-uninstall and automatic restart are disabled; update/uninstall use the community plugin manager. Revert the private overlay before uninstall.
Prompt, rules and skills retain the current DSH_HOME paths, which can be shared by profiles using the same home. Existing customized prompt content is preserved on startup.
Full Electron desktop, model API, every preset and session rewind workflow have not been executed end to end; no author endorsement or universal compatibility claim.

Optional native hooks that modify host-wide deny rules are disabled. Actual web composition matched 34 patches and 11 existing matches; 30 optional or layout-specific patches were unmatched and are reported.
Existing RedTeam presets, skills and setup script are preserved on startup; existing database rows and legacy columns are not removed or automatically rewritten.
